glosses: to understate oneself (i.e. one's position, capabilities, etc.)

examples.text: „Es clasht nicht, wir haben in dieser Koalition Dinge, die zurechtgerüttelt werden müssen. Das ist völlig normal“, stapelt der Kanzler die Konflikte tief.
examples.translation: “There aren't any clashes, in this coalition we have things that have to be shaken up. That is totally normal,” the chancellor understates the conflicts.
